#1 Following a suggestion of a friend of Urs’s, the display of nLab pages on a mobile should now be better. See github for the change and some further comments.

Definitely there is still plenty of room for improvement, especially around the top of a typical page. If anybody wishes to work on that/come with suggestions, they are very welcome.
